# Tech Lead Shift

> Articles by Charles Betancourt on leading hybrid teams of human workers and autonomous AI agents: culture, accountability, and where current leadership frameworks fail. New articles twice a month, on Wednesdays, on Substack. A COTIB LLC media brand.

## Core Pages

- [Latest (/)](https://techleadshift.com/): The newest article, recent articles, a Start here shelf for the Core Series, and how to subscribe.
- [Archive (/archive)](https://techleadshift.com/archive): Every article, newest first. The Core Series (the prologue and the first ten articles) is marked.
- [Work with Charles (/work)](https://techleadshift.com/work): Consulting and speaking inquiries.

## Where the articles live

- [Substack](https://techleadshift.substack.com): Every article is published here first. RSS: https://techleadshift.substack.com/feed

## Related
